name: pogo-lens
description: React Native companion for Pokémon GO: shared IV ranking and nickname workflow, Android overlay and iOS screen capture.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pogo-lens/core && npm run lint -w @pogo-lens/workflow && npm run lint -w @pogo-lens/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pogo-lens/core && npm run typecheck -w @pogo-lens/workflow && npm run typecheck -w @pogo-lens/mobile
scripts.test: npm test -w @pogo-lens/core && npm test -w @pogo-lens/workflow && npm test -w @pogo-lens/mobile -- --runInBand
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pogo-lens/core && npm run build -w @pogo-lens/workflow
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
